title: Show HN: Offrun – manage every coding agent from one workspace
summary: Offrun is a unified workspace that allows developers to run and monitor multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, AGY, Grok Build) simultaneously from a single interface, providing visibility into agent activity, status, and account usage/credits.
problem_solved: Developers managing multiple AI coding agents lack unified visibility and context, forcing them to switch between separate tools and lose track of agent activity and resource usage.
why_valuable: It provides a single pane of glass for AI coding workflows, eliminating context switching and offering centralized monitoring of multiple AI coding tools and their account resources.
